summary: Blue Gold Ltd filed Form 6-K to disclose the resignation of COO Gus Gomes effective July 26, 2026, with no disagreement cited; he will join the advisory board. The filing also notifies Nasdaq of its election to follow Cayman Islands home country practice exempting it from the 20% shareholder approval rule under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(d), supported by a legal opinion from Mourant Ozannes. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender is involved. This is a routine governance update with no financial terms, deal structure, or actionable event.
